uncommitted_source_change_scope: FirmwareTarget.h physical board selection changed from committed CYD to AMOLED; comparison normalizes only that board-selection line.
provenance_scope: Manual build exports compared with current firmware source and copied build inputs; no cryptographic source-to-binary attestation.

physical_board_acceptance.confirmation_question: Have all five 1.1.44 builds passed hardware testing: boot and USB identity, Wi-Fi/app connection, display and touch where supported, SD playback and saving, and offline/recovery behavior?
physical_board_acceptance.scope: All five included 1.1.44 boards: boot and USB identity, Wi-Fi/app connection, display and touch where supported, SD playback and saving, offline/recovery behavior.

credential_free_build_evidence.limitation: A successful build/package and source inspection are not cryptographic proof of credential absence. No secrets.h was read. Any reused objects retain copied source/dependency comparison evidence.

source_comparison.normalization: CRLF to LF; remove compiler #line directives; trim trailing whitespace/outer blank lines; remove generated setup/loop declarations in .ino.cpp; ignore only board selection in FirmwareTarget.h.

A false value alone does not demonstrate failure of the selected export; supplied ELF/BIN/source/object correspondence and maintainer acceptance are recorded independently.
